intent: H1 and filesystem-derived fallback titles feed one SkillRecord.title authority surface and must share the explicit resource/semantic admission contract without broad-strip laundering of edge controls. This delta is provenance only and does not claim owner wiring.
processScar: The first pass protected fallback only; the second converged H1/fallback but proposed admission after line.strip(). Review found Python broad stripping can remove edge Cc whitespace such as U+0085 before semantic admission. The corrected owner delta parses the decoded raw Markdown line through admit_markdown_h1_title, which removes only structural CR/LF plus ordinary ASCII-space margin and rejects H1-looking lines that depend on broader hidden-control normalization.

changes.before: stripped = line.strip(); if stripped.startswith('# '): derive/strip title, resource-check, return title
changes.after: title = admit_markdown_h1_title(line, max_chars=MAX_SKILL_TITLE_CHARS); if title is not None: return title
changes.reason: semantic admission must observe edge controls before broad whitespace normalization can erase them
skill title failed the declared source resource/semantic contract
